Gurupreet Singh • 1st Revenue Operations Manager at Indpro AB | Driving Growth through Sales & Marketing Automation | Data-Driven Strategy & Operations 1mo • End of week numbers check. This is the RevOps discipline I run every Friday. Sharing it because more teams should do this for their engineering function. Five numbers I pull every week: Deploy frequency, how often did we ship to production this week? This is the heartbeat of the delivery system. If it dropped, I want to know why before Monday. PR review cycle average, across all PRs that were opened and closed this week, what was the average number of review cycles? Above 2 is a signal. Above 3 is a problem. Post-deploy incident count, how many production issues were raised within 48 hours of a deployment this week? Each one is a guardrail calibration candidate. Demo-ready lag, how many features are currently marked "engineering complete" but not confirmed demo-ready? Every day in this state is deal momentum at risk. SKILL.md update count, how many times was the SKILL.md library updated this sprint? If the answer is zero, the system is not learning. These five numbers take 15 minutes to pull on Friday afternoon. They tell you more about the health of your delivery system than a 2-hour sprint retrospective. The #AICodeFactory generates all of them as outputs. In most traditional workflows, you have to build the instrumentation to get them at all. → https://indpro.se/contact #AICodeFactory #IndproAB #RevOps #EngineeringMetrics #DeliverySystem #B2BSaaS #NordicTech … more 3 ​ ​

Gurupreet Singh • 1st Revenue Operations Manager at Indpro AB | Driving Growth through Sales & Marketing Automation | Data-Driven Strategy & Operations 1mo • The first 30 days of a Data Team as a Service engagement. Here is what that actually looks like operationally. Days 1–3: access and environment setup. Repository, data warehouse credentials, pipeline tooling, communication channels. The team is in the data before end of day 3. Days 4–10: audit. We map every existing pipeline, what it does, what it feeds, when it last failed, what the failure mode looks like, whether anyone is monitoring it. This audit is not a presentation. It is a working document that becomes the SKILL.md for the data infrastructure. Days 11–20: first deliverable. Based on the audit, we identify the highest-priority item, usually either the pipeline that is causing the most operational pain or the data asset that is blocking the highest-value downstream decision. We fix it, document it, hand it over. Days 21–30: rhythm established. The team is operating inside the #AICodeFactory methodology, daily async standups, documented decisions, SKILL.md maintained and growing. The Stockholm lead has met weekly with the client's data owner. The first sprint retrospective has happened. By day 30, the client has a running data team that already knows their infrastructure, has shipped at least one meaningful deliverable, and is operating at a sustainable pace. The 12-day deployment number we quote refers to team access. Day 30 is when the team is genuinely integrated. Both numbers are real. They describe different things. → https://indpro.se/contact #AICodeFactory #IndproAB #DataEngineering #ManagedTeams #DataTeam #NordicTech #B2BSaaS … more 2 ​ ​

Gurupreet Singh • 1st Revenue Operations Manager at Indpro AB | Driving Growth through Sales & Marketing Automation | Data-Driven Strategy & Operations 1mo • Customer churn dropped 23% in one quarter. We did not change the product. We did not change the pricing. We did not run a customer success intervention. 6/28 We fixed the churn model. The company had a churn prediction model that had been running for 18 months. It was producing scores. The CS team was working from those scores. But the intervention rate on predicted churners was only 34% - meaning 66% of at-risk accounts were being flagged and not contacted. When we audited the model, we found three problems. The model was trained on 14-month-old data. The product had launched three new features since then. Usage patterns had shifted. The model did not know. The at-risk score threshold was set too low. The CS team was receiving 40 flagged accounts per week. They had capacity to meaningfully contact 12. The list was too long to action, so they triaged by gut instead of score. The highest-signal churn indicator - a drop in a specific API call call sequence - was not in the model at all. It had been identified by an engineer 6 months earlier but never made it into the training data. We retrained with current data. We raised the threshold. We added the API signal. Intervention rate went from 34% to 81%. Churn dropped 23% in the following quarter. The #AlCodeFactory data practice runs this kind of model audit as standard. → https://indpro.se/contact #AICodeFactory #IndproAB #DataEngineering #CustomerSuccess #ChurnPrediction #B2BSaaS #NordicTech … more 2 ​ ​
